_comment: FICTIONAL demo policy. Synthetic data only; not a real contract. Modeled on the Calingo 'Unfall- & Krankenversicherung fuer Hunde und Katzen' AVB, December 2025 edition. See ../README.md.

avb.modeled_on: Calingo Insurance AG, AVB Unfall- & Krankenversicherung fuer Hunde und Katzen, Ausgabe Dezember 2025

cost_sharing.deductible_basis: per cat, per policy year; prevention costs count toward it

accident_illness_base.notes: Annual limit below CHF 12'000, so extra costs of a vet house call are NOT covered (AVB 1.2.5).

prevention.notes: Paid only after the annual deductible is used up (AVB 1.2.3). No waiting period.

emergency_pet_care.notes: Boarding when the policyholder or a family member is hospitalised in an emergency (AVB 1.2.4). Limit is per cat. Not a vet cost, so this demo schedule pays it in full up to the limit, outside the deductible.

prescription_diet.notes: Sub-limit inside the base annual limit (AVB 1.2.9).

complementary_medicine.notes: Physiotherapy, acupuncture, hydrotherapy, osteopathy, laser therapy, homeopathy NOT covered (AVB 1.2.6).

advanced_treatments.notes: Stem cells, gene therapy, prostheses NOT covered (AVB 1.2.7).

pre_existing_conditions.notes: Add-on not taken for any cat. Pre-existing conditions and their consequences are excluded (AVB 1.4 e).

required_documents: original vet invoice: first-diagnosis date, treatment date, animal name, diagnosis, services and medicines, amounts, vet name/address/phone
